songs.title: Good King Wenceslas

songs.title: Away in a Manger

challenges.title: Scale Climber
challenges.desc: Up the scale and back down, one glowing note at a time.

challenges.title: Stay in Key
challenges.desc: 30 notes, no spicy ones. Improvise freely.

challenges.title: Echo Me
challenges.desc: Watch a melody that grows each round, then play it back.

challenges.title: Chord Builder
challenges.desc: Hold the named chord with all its notes at once.

challenges.title: Speed Run
challenges.desc: How many in-key notes can you fit into 15 seconds?

challenges.title: Note Detective
challenges.desc: A note name appears. Track it down on the keys.

challenges.title: Interval Jumper
challenges.desc: Leap a 3rd, 5th or octave above the shown note.

challenges.title: Rhythm Copy
challenges.desc: Tap the dot pattern on any key. Gaps matter, notes do not.

challenges.title: Black Keys Only
challenges.desc: 25 notes, zero white keys. It is impossible to sound bad.

challenges.title: Mirror Mode
challenges.desc: Flip each note around the middle D. Your brain will squeak.

challenges.title: Loud & Soft
challenges.desc: Whisper or thunder, on request. Your touch is the controller.

challenges.title: Major or Minor?
challenges.desc: Hear a chord, answer C for happy or A for moody.

challenges.title: Glissando Dash
challenges.desc: Sweep every white key, low to high, as fast as you dare.

challenges.title: Boss Level
challenges.desc: Five random mini-tasks back to back. No save point.

challenges.title: Daily Challenge
challenges.desc: One challenge per day, same for everyone. Come back tomorrow.

games.title: Zombie Lanes
games.blurb: Zombies march down the lanes toward your keys. Play the note on the zombie to blast it.

games.title: Jiu-Jitsu Flow
games.blurb: Roll on the mats. Answer your partner's moves with the right notes, keep the flow, and earn your belts.

games.title: Runway Remix
games.blurb: Style a model through the eras of music, then play the era's piece on the beat so they strut the runway.

games.title: Phrase Match
games.blurb: Flip cards to hear short tunes, find the twins, then play each tune back on the keys to win the pair.

games.title: Harvest Feast
games.blurb: Learn a Thanksgiving song step by step, from hunt-and-peck to master. Every phrase you nail puts a dish on the table.
games.skill: Memorize songs, one level at a time

games.title: Light the Tree
games.blurb: Learn a Christmas song step by step, from hunt-and-peck to master. Every phrase hangs an ornament, and master puts the star on top.

emulators.title: Koog Air
emulators.blurb: A hands-in-the-air instrument: slide across the pad and the pitch glides smoothly with no steps between notes.

emulators.title: Koog Ribbon
emulators.blurb: A ribbon-and-ring instrument: slide your finger to glide between notes, add finger wobble (vibrato), and pick one of four speaker colours.

emulators.title: Koog Wheelhouse
emulators.blurb: A drawbar organ with no pipes: nine sliders mix harmonics together like a recipe, and a spinning-speaker cabinet makes the sound swirl.

emulators.title: Koog Tape Choir
emulators.blurb: A tape-style keyboard: it imitates strings, flute and choir with tape wobble and age, and the tape runs out after about eight seconds, so players learn to let go of a ...

emulators.title: Koog Ladder
emulators.blurb: A one-voice-at-a-time analog-style synth: three detunable oscillators feed a steep four-pole low-pass filter, and an envelope opens the filter on each note.

emulators.title: Koog Patchbay
emulators.blurb: A semi-modular style synth: it plays right away, but sliders and a patch bay let you rewire what controls the pitch, the filter and the loudness.

emulators.title: Koog Squelch
emulators.blurb: A bass-line box: fill in the 16 steps, add Accent and Slide to some of them, then sweep Cutoff and Resonance while it plays for that squelchy, wobbling acid sound.

emulators.title: Koog Shimmer
